In 1971, money stopped being real — and nobody told you 💵

On August 15th, 1971, Nixon appeared on TV for 15 minutes and announced the US would no longer exchange dollars for gold.

Before that: every dollar was backed by physical gold stored in Fort Knox.

After that: every dollar in existence was backed only by trust in the US government.

This is called fiat currency — money that has value because the government says it does.

Every major currency on earth followed within two years.

All of modern finance runs on that 1971 decision.

Bankruptcy won't save you from student loans 😤

In the US, you can discharge in bankruptcy:
• Credit card debt ✅
• Medical debt ✅
• Gambling debt ✅
• Business loans ✅

Student loans ❌

In 1976, Congress carved student loans out of standard bankruptcy protection. Expanded in 1998.

To discharge student debt, you must prove 'undue hardship' — a legal standard so difficult that fewer than 1% of filers succeed.

The myth that 'you can always file bankruptcy' doesn't apply to the one debt that's crushing most people.
